messages:
maya: quick sync request — Compliance asked for a compact "who changed this" flow on routing policy rows. They want: 1) quick console link to the exact audit event, 2) ability to include the routing snapshot + quota state in export bundles. Can we outline what to ship as a fast win vs. long term?

 tj: fast win = console deep-link to existing export artifact if available. long term = add snapshots inline (or presigned) in exports. how are consumers expecting snapshots delivered?

 sam: consumers prefer NDJSON (streamable). Snapshot assets as presigned URLs in a manifest is the usual pattern. Manifest + lines = easy to consume.

 anna: redaction first: routing entries may contain tenant names, comments with hostnames/IPs. Exports must support redaction levels: none|minimal|strict. We should reuse the actor/email redaction flags we already have.

 ryan: architect note: avoid coupling export consumers to our identity service. Exports should carry a de-identified display field (actor_hint) and actor_id. That way legal teams can see human-readable names without us resolving emails.

 tj: API naming bikeshed: include_provenance vs include_snapshots. I prefer include_provenance=true which toggles bundle generation and adds schema_version=v2.

 maya: agreed — v2 for export schema. Also include provenance_granularity param (full|hourly|sampled). Default sampled for self-serve, full for compliance customers.

 lisa: UX suggestion: add a tiny provenance pill next to routing policy rows: e.g. "changed 2h • maya" (click opens side panel). Panel shows diff, routing snapshot timestamp, quota badge (green/yellow/red) and button "Download snapshot". For rollouts show rollout id and link to rollout trace.

 sam: backend needs a compact quota snapshot: {ts, tokens_used, throttle_count, rejection_rate}. Keep it small and cacheable for UI.

 anna: sampling policy: for heavy-change tenants we should support daily rollups instead of full event stream to limit export size. Compliance customers opt-in for full forensics.

 ryan: security requirement: manifests and snapshot URLs should be tamper-evident. We'll HMAC-sign the manifest and include X-Export-Signature header. Store signing metadata in export record.

 auditor-bot: export created: export-1767123456 by maya. manifest v2 generation queued. ETA ~8m.

 tj: endpoints to add: POST /v1/exports?include_provenance=true&granularity=full and GET /v1/routing-snapshots/:id (returns metadata + presigned URL). Add schema v2 docs and migration notes. Feature-flag rollout.

 ryan: also add verification endpoint GET /v1/exports/:id/verify to return signing metadata for manual/legal verification.

 anna: please document redaction semantics clearly and include an example NDJSON event line with possible redaction outputs.

 maya: action owners:
- tj: export API param + open v2 schema PR
- sam: manifest + presigned snapshot storage + NDJSON generator
- ryan: HMAC signing + verify endpoint + store signing meta
- lisa: provenance pill + side-panel mockups + copy
- anna: redaction/sampling policy doc + legal checklist

 tj: i'll start the PRs and mark them WIP. tagging eng-oncall for potential S3/storage churn.

 maya: target: canary in 2 sprints, full after legal signoff. We'll iterate on UI copy after mocks.

 lisa: pill copy suggestion: "changed 2h — maya • download audit". We can shorten if it clutters.

 sam: note for perf: keep routing_snapshot metadata under ~1KB for fast list rendering. full snapshots are stored externally (presigned).

 ryan: we should add telemetry: how often provenance pill is clicked, export creation rate per tenant, and export size distribution. Will add to console telemetry dashboard.

 maya: perfect. I'll post design comps and legal checklist here when ready. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
